53300.commentary: (MNa) mokkhacikan'ti samparivattakakīḷā, ākāse vā daṇḍakaṃ gahetvā bhūmiyaṃ vā sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā heṭṭhupariyabhāvena parivattanakīḷanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.

53301.meaning1: is freed; is liberated; is emancipated (from)
53301.commentary: (DHPa) mokkhanti mārabandhanā'ti sabb'ete kilesabandhan'ābhāvena mārabandhanasaṅkhātā tebhūmakavaṭṭā muccissantī'ti.
53301.notes: Originally desiderative of √muc. √muc + sa > moksa + ya > mokkha

examples.text: dūraṅ'gamaṃ ekacaraṃ, asarīraṃ guh'āsayaṃ, ye cittaṃ saṃyamessanti, mokkhanti mārabandhanā.

53302.meaning1: path to liberation; way to freedom

examples.text: tasmiṃ samaye satthā pavattitavaradhammacakko anupubben'āgantvā anāthapiṇḍikena mahāseṭṭhinā catupaṇṇāsakoṭidhanaṃ vissajjetvā kārite jetavanamahāvihāre viharati mahājanaṃ saggamagge ca mokkhamagge ca patiṭṭhāpayamāno.

53304.meaning1: intending to get free; aiming at escape

examples.text: anāpatti kenaci viheṭhīyamāno mokkh'ādhippāyo pahāraṃ deti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

53305.meaning2: name of a classical Pāḷi grammar; Moggallānabyākaraṇaṃ

53306.commentary: (ANa) yamako'ti-ādīni tesaṃ nāmāni. tesu hi eko yamako nāma, eko moggallo nāma, eko uggo nāma, eko nāvindakī nāma, eko gandhabbo nāma, eko aggivesso nāma.

examples.text: ime'pi rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā, yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.

53307.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; chief disciple; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in psychic power
53307.commentary: (AN 1.190) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ iddhimantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāmoggallāno (UDa) mahāmoggallāno'ti pūjāvacanaṃ. guṇavisesehi mahanto moggallāno'ti hi mahāmoggallāno.

examples.text: idh'āvuso moggallāna, bhikkhu cittaṃ vasaṃ vatteti, no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattati. so yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ, tāya vihārasamāpattiyā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ viharati.
tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, uṭṭhāy'āsanā udakena akkhīni anumajjitvā disā anuvilokeyyāsi, nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni ullokeyyāsi

53308.commentary: (VINa) mahāmoggallāno'ti mahā ca so guṇamahantatāya moggallāno ca gottenā'ti mahāmoggallāno.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavāḷaputtagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

53309.meaning1: name of an eminent grammatical treatise

examples.text: apurakkharāno [apurekkharāno (sī, suttanipātepi) moggallāne 5-135 suttam'pi oloketabbaṃ]
daḷhadhammo bahūsu ṭīkā ca moggallānabyākaraṇaṃ ca oloketabbaṃ

53318.meaning1: useless; pointless; futile; ineffective; unprofitable; vain
53318.synonym: anatthasaṃhita, aphala, natthāvaha, niratthaka, mūḷharūpa, sampha

examples.text: na tena thero so hoti, yen'assa palitaṃ siro, paripakko vayo tassa, moghajiṇṇo'ti vuccati.

tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā n'ābhinipphajjanti. so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati, moghaṃ vata me uṭṭhānaṃ, aphalo vata me vāyāmo'ti

53319.meaning1: grown old in vain; waste of old age; useless old man; foolish old man
53319.commentary: (DHPa) moghajiṇṇo'ti anto therakarānaṃ dhammānaṃ abhāvena tucchajiṇṇo nāma

examples.text: na tena thero so hoti, yen'assa palitaṃ siro, paripakko vayo tassa, moghajiṇṇo'ti vuccati.

53320.meaning1: fool; worthless man; useless person; stupid person

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, moggallāna, abbhutaṃ, moggallāna! yāva bāhāgahaṇā'pi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatī'ti
atha ca pan'idh'ekacce moghapurisā pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti.

53321.meaning1: 'anything else is wrong'; 'everything else is stupid'
53321.commentary: (DNa) idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti idaṃ amhākam'eva vacanaṃ saccaṃ, aññesaṃ vacanaṃ moghaṃ tucchaṃ niratthakan'ti.

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana ajānanto apassanto ek'aṃsena ādāya vohareyyaṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti, na m'etaṃ assa patirūpaṃ.

53322.meaning1: anything else is wrong; everything else is useless
53322.commentary: (DNa) idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti idaṃ amhākam'eva vacanaṃ saccaṃ, aññesaṃ vacanaṃ moghaṃ tucchaṃ niratthakan'ti.

examples.text: iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti tathā tathā thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharati, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti.

53323.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in wearing coarse robes
53323.commentary: (NIDD2) mogharājā'ti bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ nāmena ālapati. (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto kassapassa bhagavato kāle kaṭṭhavāhanassa nāma rañño amacco hutvā tena satthu ānayanatthaṃ purisasahassena pesito satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vīsativassasahassāni samaṇadhammaṃ katvā tato cuto ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ sugatīsu'y'eva parivattento imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā mogharājā'ti laddhanāmo bāvarībrāhmaṇassa santike uggahitasippo saṃvegajāto tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā tāpasasahassaparivāro ajitādīhi saddhiṃ satthu santikaṃ pesito tesaṃ pannarasamo hutvā pañhe pucchitvā pañhavissajjanapariyosāne arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
53323.notes: Theragāthā verses 207-208 (TH2.44, TH164) are attributed to him.

examples.text: suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu, mogharāja sadā sato, att'ānudiṭṭhiṃ ūhacca, evaṃ maccutaro siyā, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passatī'ti.
chavipāpaka cittabhaddaka, mogharāja satataṃ samāhito, hem'antikasītakālarattiyo, bhikkhu tvaṃ'si kathaṃ karissasi.

53329.meaning1: intending to release; aiming to ejaculate

examples.text: kim'atthakāmo na dade, kiṃ macco na pariccaje, kiṃsu muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikaṃ na ca mocaye'ti.
attānaṃ na dade poso, attānaṃ na pariccaje, vācaṃ muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikañ'ca na mocaye'ti.

53336.commentary: (ANa) mutto mocemi bandhanā'ti ahaṃ sabbabandhanehi mutto hutvā mahājanampi rāgādibandhanato mocemi.

examples.text: so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti. so tattha bajjhati. hatthaṃ mocessāmī'ti dutiyena hatthena gaṇhāti.
so'haṃ vijitasaṅgāmo, mutto mocemi bandhanā, nāgo'mhi paramadanto, asekho parinibbuto'ti.

53337.meaning2: to deliver, to set free, to release

53338.meaning2: having delivered, having set free, having released

examples.text: sace vo, dhanena attho, khippaṃ maṃ bandhanā mocetvā sīsaṃ nhāpetvā ahatavatthāni acchādetvā gandhehi vilimpāpetvā pupphāni pilandhāpetvā ṭhapethā'ti.

53342.meaning1: could be sensed; should be perceived; can be known

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… mutvā motabbaṃ, mutaṃ na maññati, amutaṃ na maññati, motabbaṃ na maññati, motāraṃ na maññati
iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… mutvā motabbaṃ, mutaṃ na maññati, amutaṃ na maññati, motabbaṃ na maññati, motāraṃ na maññati
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisassa ucchaṅge nānākhajjakāni ākiṇṇāni, tilā taṇḍulā modakā badarā. so tamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahanto satisammosā pakireyya.

53345.meaning1: is happy; is glad; is pleased; rejoices
53345.commentary: (ITIa) saggamhi modatī'ti kām'āvacaradevaloke aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi abhibhavitvā dibbasukhaṃ anubhavanto icchitanipphattiyā'va modati pamodati lalati kīḷatī'ti.

examples.text: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.
parasambhatesu bhogesu, vasavattī'va modare, diṭṭhe dhamm'esa vipāko, samparāye ca suggatī'ti.

53348.commentary: (DNa) mudā modamānā'ti modā modamānā. ayam'eva vā pāṭho, aññam'aññaṃ pamuditacittā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anuppīḷā manussā mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apārutagharā maññe viharanti.
opammaṃ upadassetvā, kittito me mahāmuni, buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ kittetvā, kappaṃ saggamhi mod'ahaṃ.
opammaṃ upadassetvā, kittito me mahāmuni, buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ kittetvā, kappaṃ saggamhi mod'ahaṃ.
na monena munī hoti, mūḷharūpo aviddasu, yo ca tulaṃ'va paggayha, varam'ādāya paṇḍito.
yo ca jānaṃ saṃyat'atto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam'arahati, sa munī monam'ajjhagā'ti.
ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.

53355.commentary: (SNa) monan'ti catumaggañāṇaṃ, tañ'hi munātī'ti monaṃ, catusaccadhamme jānātī'ti attho.

examples.text: yadā ca attanā vedi, muni monena brāhmaṇo, atha rūpā arūpā ca, sukhadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
na mānakāmassa damo idh'atthi, na monam'atthi asamāhitassa, eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto, na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.

53356.meaning1: attained silence; (or) attained sainthood; (comm) attained understanding

examples.text: nisabhassa appameyyassa, gambhīrassa monapattassa, khemaṅ'karassa vedassa, dhammaṭṭhassa saṃvut'attassa, saṅgātigassa muttassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

53357.meaning1: ways of sage-hood; pathways of monkhood; (comm) path of wisdom
53357.commentary: (UDa) monapathesu sikkhato'ti arahattañāṇasaṅkhātassa monassa pathesu sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhammesu tīsu vā sikkhāsu sikkhato. idañ'ca pubbabhāgappaṭipadaṃ gahetvā vuttaṃ. pariniṭṭhitasikkho hi arahā, tasmā evaṃ sikkhato, imāya sikkhāya munibhāvaṃ pattassa munino'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo. yasmā ca etadeva, tasmā heṭṭhimamaggaphalacittānaṃ vasena adhicetaso, catusaccasambodhapaṭipattiyaṃ appamādavasena appamajjato, maggañāṇasamannāgamena munino'ti evam'etesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ padānaṃ attho yujjati'y'eva. (SNPa) monapathesū'ti ñāṇapathesu.

examples.text: yaṃ me kaṅkhitam'aññāsi, vicikicchā maṃ tārayi namo te, muni monapathesu pattipatta, akhila ādiccabandhu sorato'si.
tvañ'ca me maggam'akkhāhi, añjasaṃ amat'ogadhaṃ, ahaṃ monena monissaṃ, gaṅgāsoto'va sāgaran'ti.
anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.
moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava.

53360.commentary: (SNPa) moneyyasampannan'ti paññāsampannaṃ, kāyamoneyy'ādisampannaṃ vā. (NIDD1a) moneyyasampannan'ti jānitabbaṃ jānitvā phale ṭhitattā moneyyasampannaṃ.

examples.text: kāyamuniṃ vacīmuniṃ, cetomuniṃ anāsavaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.
sīm'antānaṃ vinetāraṃ, jātimaraṇakovidaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, tādisaṃ yaññam'āgataṃ.

53363.meaning1: very foolish; completely confused; totally deluded; entirely stupid

examples.text: jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
no ce kira diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, maññām'ahaṃ momuham'eva dhammaṃ, diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ.

53364.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of momuha, intens
53364.meaning1: as very foolish; as completely confused; as totally deluded; as entirely stupid

examples.text: diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.

53365.meaning1: very foolish; extremely confused; deeply deluded

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā mando hoti momūho. so mandattā momūhattā tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ, evan'ti'pi me no, tathā'ti'pi me no, aññathā'ti'pi me no, no'ti'pi me no, no no'ti'pi me no'ti.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, sottaṃ. sottaṃ kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, vañjhaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi, aphalaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi, momūhaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi

53366.meaning1: total confusion; complete bewilderment; total stupidity; (comm) deeply deluded state

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā aññaṃ byākaroti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato aññaṃ byākaroti, ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṃ byākaroti, adhimānena aññaṃ byākaroti, samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaroti.
mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātu'kāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati

53367.commentary: (ANa) moro vā kaṭṭhaṃ pātetī'ti… moraggahaṇena ca idha sabbapakkhiggahaṇaṃ adhippetaṃ, tena yo koci pakkhī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tattha ca me, brāhmaṇa, viharato mago vā āgacchati, moro vā kaṭṭhaṃ pāteti, vāto vā paṇṇakasaṭaṃ ereti.
app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.

53369.commentary: (MNa) moranivāpe'ti tasmiṃ ṭhāne morānaṃ abhayaṃ ghosetvā bhojanaṃ adaṃsu. tasmā taṃ ṭhānaṃ moranivāpo'ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā paribbājakā moranivāpe paribbājak'ārāme paṭivasanti, seyyath'idaṃ, annabhāro varadharo sakul'udāyī ca paribbājako aññe ca abhiññātā abhiññātā paribbājakā.

53371.meaning1: in reference to AN3.144 Paṭhamamoranivāpasutta, AN3.145 Dutiyamoranivāpasutta and AN3.146 Tatiyamoranivāpasutta

examples.text: yodho parisamittañ'ca, uppādā kesakambalo, sampadā vuddhi tayo, assā tayo moranivāpino'ti.

53374.meaning1: attractive as a bundle of peacock's tail feathers

53376.commentary: (DNa) pippalivaniyā moriyā'pi ajātasattu-ādayo viya dūtaṃ pesetvā yuddhasajjā'va nikkhamiṃsu.

examples.text: assosuṃ kho pippalivaniyā moriyā, bhagavā kira kusinārāyaṃ parinibbuto'ti.
tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.
etaṃ dukkhan'ti ñatvāna, mosadhammaṃ palokinaṃ, phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha vijānati, vedanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
māno hi te brāhmaṇa khāribhāro, kodho dhūmo bhasmani mosavajjaṃ, jivhā sujā hadayaṃ jotiṭhānaṃ, attā sudanto purisassa joti.

53379.commentary: (MNa) mosadhammā'ti nassanasabhāvā, khettaṃ viya vatthu viya hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ca na paññāyittha, katip'āhen'eva supinake diṭṭhā viya nassanti na paññāyanti. tena vuttaṃ mosadhammā'ti

examples.text: tassa sā vimutti sacce ṭhitā akuppā hoti. tañ'hi, bhikkhu, musā yaṃ mosadhammaṃ, taṃ saccaṃ yaṃ amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ.
yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā, tañ'hi tassa musā hoti, mosadhammañ'hi ittaraṃ.

53381.meaning1: worthy of being clubbed; punishable by clubbing
53381.meaning2: worthy of being slain (with clubs); punishable

examples.text: ahaṃ, bhante, pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ, yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomī'ti.
māno hi te brāhmaṇa khāribhāro, kodho dhūmo bhasmani mosavajjaṃ, jivhā sujā hadayaṃ jotiṭhānaṃ, attā sudanto purisassa joti.
mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.
lobho akusalamūlaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ idaṃ vuccat'āvuso akusalamūlaṃ.
saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.
yañ'ca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno, tañ'ca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttari c'assa moho āropetabbo. evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, āropetabbo. byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.

so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti

53386.meaning1: wearing away of delusion; extinction of stupidity

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, pariññā? rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pariññā
yathā'pi pabbato selo, acalo suppatiṭṭhito, evaṃ mohakkhayā bhikkhu, pabbato'va na vedhatī'ti.

53387.meaning1: fact of being motivated by delusion; state of being driven by ignorance
53387.commentary: (VINa) chandagāmitā… bhayagāmitā pāpentī'ti ete chandagāmino ca… bhayagāmino cā'ti evaṃ chandagāmitāya'pi… bhayagāmitāya'pi pāpenti, yojentī'ti attho.

examples.text: suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. ayaṃ itthan'nāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti.

53388.meaning1: motivated by delusion; driven by ignorance

examples.text: chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosagāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī'ti.

53389.meaning1: fire of delusion; fire of illusion

examples.text: kena ādittaṃ? rāg'agginā, dos'agginā, moh'agginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittan'ti vadāmi.

53391.meaning1: born from illusion; produced by delusion

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, api nu tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā uppajjeyyuṃ mohajā pariḷāhā kāyikā vā cetasikā vā yehi so mohajehi pariḷāhehi pariḍayhamāno dukkhaṃ sayeyyā'ti?
dosaṃ vineyya viharanto na dosajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā. mohaṃ vineyya viharāhi. mohaṃ vineyya viharanto na mohajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā.

53392.meaning1: net of delusion; web of illusion

examples.text: sukhino vata arahanto, taṇhā tesaṃ na vijjati, asmimāno samucchinno, mohajālaṃ padālitaṃ.

53393.meaning1: small amount of delusion; paucity of illusion

examples.text: katame cattāro? rāgatanuttaṃ, dosatanuttaṃ, mohatanuttaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, na parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

53394.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

53395.meaning1: ruined by delusion; spoiled by confusion; corrupted by illusion

examples.text: tiṇadosāni khettāni, mohadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītamohesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

53396.meaning1: state of delusion; characteristic of illusion

examples.text: sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho uccākulīnatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma me dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno yena me ekadā lobhadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, dosadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā'pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhantī'ti.
accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ, pisācagaṇasevitaṃ, van'antaṃ mohanaṃ nāma, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

53398.meaning1: (things which cause) delusion; stupor; infatuation; bewilderment
53398.commentary: (SNPa) mohanaṃ vuccati kāmaguṇā. ettha hi devamanussā muyhanti, tesu ajjhogāḷho hutvā. etena bahiddhābandhanaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: satto guhāyaṃ bahun'ābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.

53399.meaning1: playing dumb; pretending not to know
53399.commentary: (KVa) idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyan'ti yo evaṃ āropite mohe puna moheti, tasmiṃ mohanake puggale idaṃ pācittiyaṃ veditabbaṃ, na anāropite moheti attho.

examples.text: tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamānena na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī'ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyaṃ.
